# Method (T17, w34): seconds = each suite's first-to-last stamp span in pass-c15a7e40/main-cmd-2.log.progress.tsv (whole-second UTC stamps, so the span is whole; minimum 1),

# for the 95 suites the pass log reports (nested fixture labels such as a.test.sh are left out). The pass writes no runner timing (A-orch-26). A span starts at a suite's first section, so it is a lower bound on the suite's own time:

# on the 1aacdc03 run the runner's timing equalled the span for 56 of 95 suites and exceeded it by 0.84 s on average, 21 s at most. Taken at width 2 beside other work. Built by spans.py; rows sorted by label (C).
